name: @local/dsh-ssh-gui
description: Distributed control GUI for DeepSeek Harness — unified node abstraction (node = {id, name, transport, target}) over ssh:// remote hosts, serial:// local USB serial (reusing the dsh-workerspace serial backend) and serial-tcp:// TCP serial servers (ser2net/socat); connection management, node status, command execution (exec.run), file ops (file.get/put) and directory browsing with keyRef credential binding, riding the dsh-workspace-enhancement registry (/dsw) plus a private /ssh-gui loopback channel. Terminal console is left external — no embedded interactive terminal.
author: CNS2026495165
